patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than Instantly's shape. Workflow advantage: Instantly leans sales-engagement; LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom.; LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync..
- Workflow coverage skew: Instantly-leaning sales-engagement vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info.

Limitations — Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases; LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans).

Poor-fit cases: Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · Avoid Instantly if you actually need LinkedIn Sales Navigator's motion (LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
